summaryFa: مهمان اتاق تاریک را درست تشخیص می‌دهد، اما به‌جای خرید لامپ، کنارزدن پرده مشکل را حل می‌کند.
storyFa: بالا، مهمان برای خواندن به زحمت افتاده و لامپ قوی‌تر پیشنهاد می‌کند؛ صاحب صورتی تاریکی را می‌پذیرد. پایین، همان لامپ بدون تغییر مانده و بازکردن پرده نور روز را روی همان کتاب می‌اندازد.
meaningFa: وقتی کسی از تجربهٔ یک مشکل می‌گوید به آن گوش کن، ولی گزارش مشکل را با علت و درمان آن یکی نگیر.
fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Use case: illustration-story. Make one NEW square illustration, a TWO-panel comic stacked TOP TO BOTTOM, for an adult Persian wisdom book. The two approved inputs provide only character proportions, watercolor medium, tiny white glints, soft cheeks and eye/lash design.
MEANING: A user's experience of a problem can be true, even when their proposed technical fix is wrong. Respect the report and investigate before choosing a remedy. A large expensive fix is not always needed.
TOP PANEL: A simple home reading room at midday is dim because a THICK opaque dark-purple curtain is pulled completely across a large window. Daylight peeks around the curtain's edge. A mint-green adult visitor is standing by a small table looking with genuine difficulty at a simple open book facing THEM correctly; the book has no readable writing. The ceiling pendant lamp already shines weakly. Mint says exactly "اینجا تاریکه؛ لامپِ قوی‌تر بخر!" A rose-pink owner, with only two subtle upper-outer eyelashes and otherwise the same neutral anatomy, stands beside the visitor, listens kindly and agrees exactly "تاریکه، درست می‌گی." The owner is looking around the dim room, not dismissing the complaint. No giant replacement bulb is physically installed.
BOTTOM PANEL: The SAME room, SAME lamp unchanged and same table/book. Pink has gently pulled the SAME curtain to ONE SIDE, revealing clear daylight and a plain window looking onto a simple leafy tree. Natural warm sun now falls onto the open book and brightens the whole room, making reading easy. The mint visitor looks relieved and smiles appreciatively toward the owner. Pink holds the curtain edge in one hand and says with quiet gentle humor exactly "مشکل از پرده بود!" Both bodies and feet are completely visible. The visual difference must be the curtain open versus closed, not a magical new lamp or a different room. Never ridicule the visitor: darkness was a real experience, a stronger lamp was merely the wrong first remedy. Sparse props; no extra plants or extraneous decorative objects, no long explanation.
ART DIRECTION AND CHARACTER INVARIANTS: Match the attached approved book illustrations ONLY for character design and authentic restrained hand-painted watercolor, not their settings. Softly irregular broad overlapping transparent washes INSIDE the head, torso, arms, legs and hands, varying pigment density and subtle pooling, luminous paper; moderate watercolor strength. No colored-pencil or marker grain, no flat vector, no glossy 3D, no uniform embossed/crystalline texture. Contours are a darker shade of each character's own body color, not black. Every head is a simple true circle of equal width and height, never oval, no flattened chin, no ears/hair/nose. Head joins torso directly with NO NECK and a soft crescent of deeper local color under the head. Moderately built ADULT bodies exactly like the approved references: not chubby, not skinny, no bulging arms, no chibi. All bodies have the same simple neutral torso and pelvis, absolutely no breasts/bust, protruding buttocks, broad hips, pinched waist or gendered bulges. Female cue only two tiny fine upper-outer eyelashes on otherwise IDENTICAL small dark vertical oval eyes. Each dark eye MUST have one tiny reflected white glint INSIDE its dark shape; never white sclera around a pupil, never human eyeballs or frightening blank black eyes. Add subtle translucent diffuse rosy cheeks with soft watercolor edges, never flat pink discs. Minimal expressive brows and mouth. Exactly THREE fingers and ONE thumb on each visible hand (four digits total); anatomically coherent grips and limbs. No unmotivated selective clothing; aprons only if the occupation needs them. Identity and body color stay consistent in every panel.
COMPOSITION AND READABILITY: One complete square image, spacious book illustration with a clear cause and effect narrative. All full bodies, feet, hands and important objects stay completely inside the painting, never cropped at the bottom. Clean white outer paper margin, paint not touching file edges; vary natural airy watercolor vignette edges using a simple background ending naturally, no heavy black panel frames. Thin white gutters between panels. Horizontal sequences read RIGHT TO LEFT and vertical sequence TOP TO BOTTOM. Short accurate connected Persian RTL text only as specified, no English, no watermark, no captions explaining the moral. Bubble tails must point to the correct speaker. Purposeful sparse adult everyday setting, warm kind mood and gentle human wit. Every gaze, pointing hand and action must target its actual object; match perspective, physical contact and object continuity.
FRAMING: A visible strip of floor is present BELOW EVERY full foot in BOTH panels; no toe touches the middle white gutter or painting boundary. The table and characters are small enough within each panel to leave breathing room.

notesFa: نسخهٔ واقعی پس از اصلاح قاب‌بندی با view_image دیده شد؛ همهٔ پاها داخل قاب‌اند.
پرده از بسته به باز تغییر کرده، لامپ و کتاب و اتاق ثابت مانده‌اند؛ تفاوت نور واقعی و قابل پیگیری است.
سه حباب فارسی صحیح‌اند و جهتشان به گوینده درست وصل است.
قاب‌ها به‌جای کنارهم، عمودی‌اند؛ پرامپت مستقل نهایی برای همین چیدمان و حاشیهٔ کامل اصلاح شد.
qa.limitations: Occluded fingers cannot be independently counted. This is a candidate awaiting user review, not an approval.

generationHistory.description: Expanded both stacked panels to include complete feet and floor below.
generationHistory.editPromptEnglish:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY framing of this approved-style two-panel watercolor comic. Keep the EXACT two stacked panels, story, every Persian word, bubble speaker, character identity/colors, circular head shapes, anatomy, body paint, glints, lashes, cheeks, room perspective, same lamp unchanged, book orientation, and thick curtain closed in the TOP panel and opened in the BOTTOM panel.
CRITICAL CHANGE: ZOOM OUT/EXPAND THE COMPOSITION of EACH PANEL enough that all character bodies and especially ALL FEET are COMPLETELY INSIDE their panel with a visible strip of FLOOR BELOW every foot. In the TOP panel both characters' feet currently hit/cross the white middle gutter and are cut off; redraw/extend these bottom feet fully, then leave floor space before the gutter. In the BOTTOM panel also keep both full feet and all important table parts inside the image. The image remains SQUARE overall, with two equally spacious stacked panels and a thin white horizontal gutter. Slightly reduce characters within each panel if needed; do NOT squash or elongate bodies or heads. No extra furniture, new objects, changed poses or rewritten text. Preserve white outer margin and genuine layered restrained watercolor. All heads true circles, neutral bodies, no breasts or hips, no neck. Natural hands with three fingers and one thumb. This is only a targeted framing correction, not a redesign.

rootVisualReview.observations: Actual two-panel room retains same table, book, lamp and window. Friend correctly identifies darkness but proposes a stronger lamp; owner agrees about darkness and opens the blocking curtain. Light changes causally; all figures and feet fit. Pink has subtle lashes and neutral body.
